_comment: Single source of truth: which curated skill each clickable 'Skills & use
cases' menu phrase must invoke. The phrases themselves live in
packages/shared/src/content/skills.ts (the say: and tryPhrase: fields);
this file is the routing DECISION for each of them.
Read by two tests that enforce it from both ends:
apps/mobile/android/app/src/test/js/skill-activation-coverage.test.mjs
- every phrase in the catalogue has an entry here, and every target
slug ships in the curated library (existence).
services/hermes-runner/skills/delegent_routing_contract.test.mjs
- every entry here actually WINS the deterministic activation-phrase
router, with a margin (routing).
Existence and routing are different failures and have both happened:
2026-07-22/24 the library drifted off a runner (existence), and on
2026-08-03 ten of thirty chips routed to the WRONG skill through the
activation surface, e.g. 'be my sales assistant' landed on
core-permissions-and-credentials and 'set up a phone line' on
agent-email-inbox (routing).
Adding a chip to the catalogue without an entry here fails the coverage
test. Adding an entry whose skill cannot win the router fails the routing
test; fix it by adding the chip phrase to that skill's activation_phrases
in BOTH its SKILL.md frontmatter and MANIFEST.json.
